seoTitle: How to Create a Single Page Template in Elementor
metaDescription: Learn how to design a one-page website or landing page in Elementor using free widgets, and save it as a reusable template without Elementor Pro.
intro: Designing a professional single-page site — whether it's a landing page, service page, or portfolio — is fully possible in Elementor using only free tools. This guide walks through structuring the page, building out sections, and saving the finished design as a reusable template.

steps.heading: Plan your single page layout
steps.body: Sketch out the sections you need, such as a hero area, services, testimonials, and a contact section, before building in Elementor.

steps.heading: Design and customize sections
steps.body: Use Elementor's free widgets and section tools to build out each part of the page professionally, adjusting spacing and styling as you go.

steps.heading: Use free widgets effectively
steps.body: Stick to Elementor's built-in free widgets for elements like headings, images, buttons, and forms rather than relying on Pro-only features.

steps.heading: Save your design as a reusable template
steps.body: Once finished, save the page as a template so you can reuse the same structure for future projects without rebuilding from scratch.

steps.heading: Publish and test the page
steps.body: Preview the page on desktop and mobile before publishing to confirm the layout holds up across screen sizes.

faq.question: Can I build a full landing page with Elementor's free version?
faq.answer: Yes, Elementor's free version includes enough widgets and layout tools to build a complete single-page website or landing page.

faq.question: How do I save a page as a template in Elementor?
faq.answer: Use Elementor's save option to store the page design as a template, which you can then reuse or export for other projects.

faq.question: Do I need Elementor Pro to create templates?
faq.answer: No, basic template saving and reuse is available in Elementor's free version, though Pro unlocks additional template features.

faq.question: What sections work best for a single-page site?
faq.answer: Common sections include a hero banner, an about or services area, testimonials, and a contact form, depending on the page's purpose.
